exposure: Scores for Neonatal Acute Physiology-Perinatal Extension-II (SNAPPE-II)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 278 preterm infants born with gestational age less than 32 weeks and birthweight less than 1,500 g.
finding: The SNAPPE-II score, obtained within the first 12 hours of ICU admission, was identified as an independent risk factor for both bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) and retinopathy of prematurity (ROP).
